svg.title: Prelim Activity No. 1 — Conditional Formatting and Filtering
svg.desc: Illustrated coursework preview with spreadsheet formatting instructions.

g.text: ✓ Apply highlight, top/bottom, data bar, color scale, and duplicate-value rules
✓ Insert and copy columns; create and rename worksheet tabs
✓ Filter records by building and copy filtered results to a new sheet
✓ Sort last names ascending and listing prices descending
✓ Format names left-aligned and prices as Philippine pesos
✓ Save and submit the completed Excel workbook
